neighbours.label: the slot just before an expected null outcome: 'are [asymptomatic]', 'have [no symptoms]', 'except ...: [pass]'
fire: Many people with early glaucoma are often unaware that anything is wrong.
Most carriers of the bacteria have no signs of illness whatsoever.
In children the infection is usually mild or goes completely unnoticed.
Small kidney stones often pass without causing any pain.
Mild sleep apnea frequently produces no obvious daytime symptoms.
Most moles on the skin are harmless and never need treatment.
Low levels of the toxin in drinking water typically cause no harm at all.
quiet: Many people with early glaucoma notice blurred vision at night.
Most carriers of the bacteria develop fever and severe stomach cramps.
In children the infection usually causes a rash and swollen glands.
Large kidney stones often cause sharp pain in the lower back.
Severe sleep apnea frequently produces loud snoring and morning headaches.
Some moles on the skin change shape and need to be removed.
High levels of the toxin in drinking water typically cause liver damage.

notes: Card: peaks on the token before 'asymptomatic', 'no symptoms', 'pass' in except blocks; logit effect promotes nothing/negligible/unnoticed/silently/ignored. Probe: 'are asymptomatic' 0.56, 'causes no symptoms' 0.37, except/pass 0.41; 'develop a high fever' 0.23.
